_comment: Enrolled-cohort denominators per semester window (D-55). Aggregate headcounts only —
these are institutional totals, not measurements over our students, and nothing here
passes the privacy floor because there is nothing to floor. The SSC-Psych roster lists
they were derived from live outside this repo and must never enter it (D-39 custody).
Method: the two combined snapshots carry no program column, so each uid is typed
against the union of the typed lists and, for a uid in both a BA and an MA list, by the
same usage-time rule status.resolve_status applies in the pipeline (Master
Beginnsemester: S -> Mar 1, W -> Oct 1). Using a different rule here would put the
numerator and the denominator on different definitions of 'master'. Untyped residual
is 1.6% and is excluded from both levels.
Refresh: re-derive when a new roster snapshot arrives, in the roster-derivation session
beside the Excels — this repo only records the resulting counts.
